verdict.rationale: Lambda's billing docs state that On-Demand Cloud instances are billed in one-minute increments, which meets the per-minute granularity half of the story. The other half, billing only while the instance runs, is not documented. The only related evidence is a community report quoting support that running instances are billed whether idle or in use, which says nothing on billing after termination or for stopped instances. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that billing ends when an instance is terminated or stopped; billing behavior for non-running states; independent corroboration of per-minute billing.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running

citations.quote: ODC prices instances by hourly usage and bills in one-minute increments.
